title: Lead - Full Stack Software Developer
jobDescription: We are seeking a technically proficient Full Stack Software Developer with a strong background in C#, Microsoft .NET Core, Microsoft ASP.NET, Microsoft Entity Framework,SQL Server (CRUD, Stored Procedures, Views, etc), Mongo DB (NOSQL), Microsoft Blazor (with Bootstrap Blazor) Web designing (HTML, CSS,, Javascript), and cloud technologies, particularly AWS. This role demands hands-on experience in developing scalable backend systems, API integrations, and cloud storage solutions. The ideal candidate will also bring deep technical understanding of ORM tools like Entity Framework Core and Dapper, along with excellent debugging and performance tuning skills. This is an independent contributor role. ‍

The role ensures high-quality coding, workflow efficiency, compliance with payer guidelines, and timely delivery of client SLAs. The Team Lead also supports audits, training, performance management, and continuous operational improvements. ‍ Key Responsibilities Operational & Team Management Lead and manage a team of E&M coders to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets. Allocate work based on volume, complexity, and coder competency levels. Monitor team productivity and quality metrics, and ensure compliance with client SLAs. Conduct daily huddles, share updates, and communicate operational priorities. Ensure timely submission of reports, dashboards, and work queues. Quality & Compliance Review coded charts for accuracy and ensure adherence to CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, and payer-specific guidelines. Collaborate with the Quality Auditor to identify trends, errors, and root causes. Drive corrective action plans to reduce errors and improve coding accuracy. Ensure all coders follow compliance guidelines and company policies. Training & Development Identify skill gaps and provide coaching, refresher training, and guidance. Assist new coders with onboarding, process training, and evaluation. Maintain team knowledge on regulatory changes, payer updates, and code set revisions. Stakeholder & Client Coordination Serve as a point of contact for internal teams and client counterparts. Participate in client calls, audits, feedback sessions, and performance reviews. Provide timely updates on production, quality issues, and escalations. People Management Drive employee engagement, recognition, and retention initiatives within the team. Conduct performance appraisals, one-on-one discussions, and mentoring sessions. Manage shift schedules, attendance, leave approvals, and backup planning. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to optimise workflows, automate reporting, and eliminate inefficiencies. Lead initiatives to improve coding quality, reduce denials, and enhance productivity. Support operational excellence initiatives and contribute to the standardisation of processes. ‍ Skills & Competencies Required Technical Skills Certified CPC / COC / CIC preferred. Strong knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS, NCCI edits, MUE rules, and payer-specific coding guidelines. Expertise in E&M coding (office, inpatient, observation, ED E&M, consults). Familiarity with global billing rules, telehealth coding, and documentation standards. Managerial & Soft Skills Strong leadership and people management abilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Proficiency in Excel, reporting tools, and workflow management systems. ‍ Experience & Education Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent. CPC or equivalent coding certification mandatory. Total Experience: 7-10 years Relevant experience of 4–6 years of RCM coding experience , with at least 1–2 years in a lead or supervisory role. Prior experience in E&M coding processes is required. ‍ Performance Metrics (KPIs) Coding accuracy (%) Productivity (charts/hour) SLA adherence Denial reduction contribution Team engagement & retention Training effectiveness Client satisfaction ‍ Our Culture & Values At Calpion, we're not just a company—we're a dynamic culture fueled by six core values: Agile, Collaborative, Innovative, Fun, Inclusive, and Passionate.
